experiment: short joint fine-tune from v11 best_safe (200 episodes, value+policy co-trained with safety guard, k_roles=1, seed 11)
hypothesis: value quality curve showed rho(Qmin,MC) 0.80->0.884 headroom, so more value training should help
conclusion: The 200-episode joint fine-tune did NOT improve capture: nominal 0.892 vs v11-guarded 0.908 (-1.6pp), robust 0.890 vs 0.916. Value-quality headroom (rho 0.80->0.88) did NOT transfer to a capture gain in this bounded fine-tune. Possible reasons: (1) 200 eps is too short / needs longer or different recipe; (2) the frozen-policy value continuation in the probe does not reflect co-trained dynamics; (3) the ~3pp gap to the teacher is NOT a value-quality problem but an inherent distillation ceiling (equal-weight BC already ~ the teacher level).
